title: Will AI Replace Chartered Accountants?
subtitle: The future of the CA profession, and how to stay ahead
audience: CAs in practice and industry, accountants, finance managers, CA students
summary: AI is changing audit, tax and accounting faster than any change since computerisation. This session separates hype from reality: which tasks AI will take over, which judgements stay with the CA, and how practitioners can turn AI into an advantage.
